analysis.title: World peace
key_insights: Brent one-month futures fell about $2 to $114/bbl after Turkish, Saudi, Qatari and Pakistani officials met in Tehran on ending the Iran war. Iran's Supreme Leader called for conditions to be met to end the war, and nuclear issues were not discussed.
Talks in Tehran produced conditions rather than an agreement, so the market pricing of a war end is ahead of the evidence.

Israeli election turnout was near the highest since 1975, with strong Arab-Israeli turnout. Results were neck and neck at the time of writing, with odds skewed toward Netanyahu. If Eisenkot fails to form a coalition majority, Netanyahu stays in power until another election in a few months.

Europe is split on Russia. Finland and Norway leaders spoke with Putin for the first time in over a year, while Denmark and Italy criticized the move. Denmark's intelligence agency has warned of accelerating Russian hybrid attacks.
The RBNA surprised markets by leaving the cash rate unchanged at 2.75%, against market pricing.
US Treasury yields bear flattened on 10/26, continuing the October trend, ahead of the FOMC meeting. OIS pricing shows only about 1.7bp of a hike at this meeting.
Markets price almost one full Fed hike by December 2026 and another by Q3 2027. Rabobank forecasts a hold in October, a hike in December, then a hold at 4.25% through end-2027.
The Bank of Canada decides on its overnight rate. The market prices more than 80% odds of a hike, but Rabobank and a thin majority of Bloomberg-surveyed analysts expect a hold at 2.25%.
Australia releases September and Q3 inflation. Headline September CPI is estimated at 0.7% m/m, up from 0.4%, and 4.2% y/y, up from 4.0%.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Oil eased on headlines of Iran war-end talks, but remains elevated.
Rabobank expects a hold at the October meeting, a hike in December, then a hold.

macro_indicators.indicator: Fed hike pricing at October FOMC (OIS)
macro_indicators.interpretation: A hike at this meeting is effectively priced out.
The market leans toward a hike by year-end.
Rabobank diverges from market pricing of more than 80% for a hike.

risk_factors: Iran war talks produced conditions, not an agreement, and a deal could fail.
Israeli election could produce no coalition and prolong political uncertainty.
Central bank decisions (Fed, Bank of Canada) may diverge from market pricing.
vol_and_positioning: Treasury curve is bear flattening ahead of the FOMC.
OIS shows about 1.7bp of a hike priced for the October FOMC, almost one full hike by December and another by Q3 2027.
geopolitical: Turkish, Saudi, Qatari and Pakistani officials met in Tehran to try to end the Iran war; Iran's Supreme Leader called for meeting conditions to end the war.
Israeli elections: record-level turnout, neck and neck result, Netanyahu favored to stay in power.
Finland and Norway leaders spoke with Putin; Denmark and Italy criticized the call.
Danish Intelligence Agency report warns of accelerating Russian hybrid attacks on Europe.
Russia-Ukraine war continues, with Putin demanding Russia's interests be fully taken into account for peace.
